placement_summary: Abzan Houses is a VM-202 live-pilot raw packet. Its strongest source-bound signals are White-centered WBG Tarkir identity, endurance, family, house continuity, ancestor obligation, perennation, defensive patience, and false-positive boundaries against generic WBG, Dromoka's brood, Commander products, and seed files.

moral_and_psychological_profile.summary: Vox Mana models Abzan as continuity through family, ancestry, obligation, and defensive patience. This is project interpretation from normalized ABZAN evidence plus VM-198/VM-199 shaping docs, not official canon.
moral_and_psychological_profile.notes: Psychological language is Vox Mana synthesis. Support-only rows do not raise confidence.

core_values.label: Family As Continuity
core_values.description: The self belongs to a house whose elders, descendants, spouses, adopted members, ancestors, and future generations make survival communal.

core_values.label: Endurance Before Glory
core_values.description: Defense, patience, fortification, and long-game survival matter because the house must outlast pressure.

core_values.label: Perennation Through Duty
core_values.description: Life and death continuity become practical obligation through Kin-Trees, ancestor guidance, earth magic, and spirit summoning.

Look for defensive patience, fortified refuge, trade/civic resilience, and outlasting enemies as Abzan support texture.
